verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an API-driven verification service, but the evidence shows no batch or bulk endpoint. The API creates and reads verification sessions one at a time, and the review tools (override status, blocklist) act on individual verifications. A flow's static link that can 'verify any number of your users' lets one configuration be reused; it is not a bulk operation across many items, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
